notes: Second route «قال هشيم وحدثنا داود» carries the same saying (wording differs), so it is its own group; «أيضا عن الشعبي» is the shared tail.

needs_ruling: the Sha'bi reports his own visit to Fatima bint Qays in the first person («دخلت على فاطمة بنت قيس فسألتها»); her words are relayed without «عن», so she is not added. The compiler's comments («أبو عيسى»، «الشافعي») are not links.
